skill.summary: Work with Obsidian vaults (plain Markdown notes) and automate via obsidian-cli.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the obsidian skill.

- Enables working with Obsidian vaults and Markdown notes.
- Provides automation via obsidian-cli, including search, create, move, and delete functions.
- Offers guidance for vault discovery and best practices for vault path handling.
- Includes setup instructions and quick start commands for obsidian-cli.
